bsky_posts.text: 14 Oct 1972, #MichaelJackson secured his very first solo Billboard Hot 100 No.1 hit with "Ben". The ballad, written for the horror-thriller movie of the same name about a boy and his pet rat, was originally offered to Donny Osmond. The track won a Golden Globe and was nominated for an Academy Award.
